high_level_description: This image depicts a scene set in a dimly lit room with large windows that offer a view of a cityscape at night. The room is furnished with modern decor, including a sleek black coffee table, a floor lamp with a white shade, and a dark-colored side table. A television is mounted on the wall to the left, partially visible. The most striking element of the image is the vibrant, colorful cosmic event visible through the window. It appears to be a nebula or a supernova, emitting bright pink, purple, and green hues, which contrast sharply with the dark, urban landscape below.
